The blue transparent section lacks realistic refraction or depth. It appears as a flat, matte blue shape rather than a translucent plastic container holding water, failing to interact correctly with the light source.

The black power cord emerges from the body without a clear strain relief or plug housing. It appears to float slightly before connecting, and the thickness changes abruptly, suggesting a generation error in the connection point.
